batch: TCLC Box 1 (PDF BATCH); TCLC Box 3-6 (Library Scans); TCLC Box 5 (Scans)
batch_note: “TCLC Box 1,” “TCLC Box 3-6,” and “TCLC Box 5” are names of the digitization folders these photographs came from. They are project labels and do not describe where a document sits in the Kheel Center's boxes.
originals_note: Source PDFs are phone photographs with an Adobe Acrobat OCR layer. They are preserved unchanged offline; checksums below identify them exactly. Web images are derivatives rendered at native resolution and resized; some are rotated for viewing or have address labels covered. Later batches are listed under other_batches.
sequence_note: Sequence pages 1–406 follow the order of the compiled file 'BOX 1 DOCS All.pdf'. The 13 source PDFs are consecutive slices of that sequence; pages 100, 200, and 300 each appear in two adjoining slices.

other_batches.note: Page N of 'box 3-6.pdf' is the photograph 'Library - N of 281.jpeg'. Web images were rendered from the PDF at 300 dpi.

Page image b5-NNN is the NNNth photograph in filename order (Box5.jpeg, then IMG_5690 to IMG_5890; IMG_5704 and IMG_5829 are not in the folder). Web images were made from the JPEG photographs, turned upright using their orientation tags; seven sideways photographs were also rotated. IMG_5689.pdf compiles all 200 photographs in the same order; 'box 5 pg 1-10.pdf' holds photographs 2-11 and 'box 5.pdf' photographs 172-181, both with Acrobat OCR.
